name: Quire Ink
description: A self-hosted blog platform in one container: a real editor over Markdown (tables, footnotes, mathematics), scheduled publishing, newsletters over your own SMTP, comments with a built-in spam gate, cookie-free analytics, full-text search, and a book reading mode. Importers bring a WordPress, Ghost, Substack or Medium blog across with redirects and images. An AI agent can write and steward the blog over MCP. Readers download 3.9-10.4 KB of JavaScript and nothing from any third party. Everything lives in two SQLite files and one uploads folder.
short_desc: A blog you host yourself, and an AI agent can run it for you
author: Quire Ink
